title: Agentic Platform Engineering with GitHub Copilot

key_discoveries.title: Three-Act Agentic Platform Maturity Model
key_discoveries.description: Knowledge embedding → automated enforcement → autonomous operations. A staged adoption framework for adding agency to any engineering platform.

key_discoveries.title: Cluster Doctor Pattern
key_discoveries.description: Event-driven autonomous incident response: Argo CD degradation → GitHub issue → agent investigates via kubectl+MCP+eBPF → proposes fix as PR. Full pipeline automation with human approval gate only at merge.

key_discoveries.title: Rules-in-Markdown Enforcement
key_discoveries.description: Compliance/quality rules stored in plain markdown files, referenced by CI. No pipeline rebuild required to update enforcement logic. Same philosophy as CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.

key_discoveries.title: Agent Persona Definition File
key_discoveries.description: cluster-doctor.agent.md encodes persona + diagnostic workflow + safety constraints in a single markdown file. Directly applicable format for our orchestrator worker prompts.

key_discoveries.title: Workload Identity Federation
key_discoveries.description: Credential-free Azure auth for agents using ephemeral workload identity. Correct pattern for agents operating on cloud infrastructure — no static secrets stored.
